review_candidates.description: PRINT Vacancy Notice: Ref: 514366 Budget Officer in the Regional Partnerships Unit 04.09.2026 Expired Text Vacancy Notice Job title: Budget Officer (m/f/x) LOCAL AGENT GROUP I Ref: 514366 – Regional Partnerships Unit 4 September 2026 We are The European Union (EU) is an economic and political union between 27 European countries. It plays an important role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the EU is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy. The EU Delegation to the Republic of South Africa works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the South African government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit. We offer The post of Budget Officer (Local Agent Group I) in the Regional Hub Southern Africa under a fixed-term employment contract of 2 years, with a possibility of renewal under reserve of budgetary availabilities and operational considerations. For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 44 people and there are occasional atypical working hours. Under this post, the recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation, and on the changes of these needs. The successful candidate will serve under the supervision and responsibility of the Head of Regional Partnerships Unit, providing support, expertise and assistance in financial management of EU - financed programmes and projects at regional level and in the Kingdom of Lesotho, ensuring conformity with procedures for contracting, financing, and on-the-spot controls. Following Main Tasks And Duties Are Currently Required Preparation and verification of contracts, payments, recovery orders and clearings and monitoring of implementation. Ensuring compliance with the financial regulations, internal rules and local fiscal requirements. Providing advice on contractual, financial, budgetary and fiscal matters. Encoding, processing and follow up of transactions in the corporate IT systems. Financial planning, budgeting, reporting, audits, and verification on project / contracts / programs. Preparation and follow-up of audit and control plans for programs and projects, including on-the-spot checks and verification missions. Preparation and verification of tender dossiers and documents for calls for proposals. Participation in evaluation committees. The base salary will depend on relevant and verified employment experience, typically starting from ZAR78,046.00. There is a competitive benefits package, subject to certain conditions, including personal leave days and public holidays, health insurances and a retirement savings plan. The expected start date will be 01/12/2026. Minimum requirements / eligibility criteria (necessary for the application to be considered) University Degree in Accounting / Finance / Project management (min. 4 years) or equivalent. Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in financial management of development projects / programmes. Professional experience must be acquired after the date on which the qualification allowing access to the post was obtained. Working knowledge (B2) of English Right to residence and work in South Africa. Assets/selection criteria (basis for awarding points to select the best applicant) Master’s degree in accounting / finance / Project management Certification: Fraud Prevention / Financial Investigation / Development cooperation Professional experience in diplomatic mission, international financial institution or international development agency French and / or Sesotho language, OPSYS, CRIS, ABAC, SUMMA Knowledge/experience of EU policies, in the Kingdom of Lesotho How To Apply The applicant must apply by sending a cover letter, signed a Curriculum Vitæ (to include, at the minimum, exact job titles, employer’s names and detailed tasks descriptions) using one of the Europass template available at: https://europass.europa.eu/en all documents to the following email address: eeasjobs-221@eeas.europa.eu And mention in the email subject: “Ref: 514366 – Budget Officer” no later than 18:00 hours (UTC+02:00) 18/09/2026. Caution: The applicant must verify that he/she fulfills all the conditions. For easy verification, the applicant must tick all the relevant checkboxes in the application document. The absence of one of these conditions or documents is a reason for the rejection of the application The process After the deadline for applications, the eligible applications will be admitted to the Selection by the Committee set up for this purpose. Depending on the number of applications received, successive phases of Selection may include shortlisting of candidates based assessment of the information provided in the cover letter, CV; practical testing and interviews. At least the 3 best candidates will be invited to the final interview. Only candidates admitted to each successive selection phase will be contacted individually. The Delegation will not supply additional information or discuss the selection procedure. During the selection process, please do not contact the members of the Selection Committee, but address your questions and comments to the Delegation’s Administration. The successful candidate will be subject to a medical check and possible background check. Candidates who wish to lodge a complaint regarding the recruitment process may submit a written communication to the functional mailbox to which they sent the initial application. Upon receipt, the Delegation will review the matter and, where appropriate, consult Headquarters before providing a response. Equal Opportunities The European Union is committed to an equal opportunities policy for all its employees and applicants for employment. As an employer, the EU is committed to promoting gender equality, preventing discrimination on any grounds and ensuring a zero tolerance approach to any form of harassment. It actively welcomes applications from all qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds. We aim at a service which is truly representative of society, where each staff member feels respected, is able to give their best and can develop their full potential. If pre-selected, candidates with disabilities are invited to contact the Delegation delegation-s-africa-jobs@eeas.europa.eu in order to accommodate any special needs and provide assistance to ensure equality of opportunities with other candidates. If a candidate with a disability is selected and recruited, the EEAS is committed to appropriate measures in order to accommodate his or her special needs to the working place or working conditions in accordance with Art 4 of the Decision ADMIN(2025)13 of the Director-General for Resource Management of the European External Action Service on providing reasonable accommodation for local staff with disabilities working in Union Delegations. review_candidates.title: Track Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose Responsible for the safety, availability, and comfort of the track by ensuring the reliability of maintenance operations. Manage technicians and operators under his responsibility. Responsibilities/Duties Profil de candidat recherché : Track Maintenance & Technical Oversight Ensure the long-term reliability, safety, and sustainability of the LRT network’s track and workshop installations. Maintain railway safety standards and ensure sustainability of installations. Oversee the technical execution of corrective and cyclical maintenance activities. Monitor and assess track conditions, including analyzing inspection reports. Oversee the completion of maintenance projects and track inspections. Ensure proper logistics and resource availability for maintenance worksites. Conduct inventory checks for online stock and equipment during night shifts. Ensure continuity of service across maintenance operations. Team Leadership & Workforce Management Manage technicians and operators under direct responsibility. Plan, organize, supervise, and adjust team activities as needed. Contribute to the training, coaching, and development of team members. Assist in managing the transition and coordination of maintenance activities between night and day shifts. Enforce safety instructions on site to ensure the wellbeing of all staff. Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety regulations. Promote and enforce safety culture during all maintenance activities. Ensure all maintenance works are executed in alignment with safety-critical procedures. Manage emergency interventions efficiently when required. Communication & Stakeholder Coordination Facilitate effective communication with internal and external stakeholders. Align work execution with the company’s strategic objectives and operational requirements. Provide updates and support to the Track Manager as required. Planning, Reporting & Economic Management Plan, organize, and oversee maintenance activities based on operational needs. Monitor and manage the economic impact and cost-efficiency of maintenance operations. Support continuous improvement initiatives and ensure proper documentation. Complete assignments independently within established procedures and expected timelines. Additional Responsibilities Perform other duties as assigned by the Track Manager. Maintain high professionalism, positive attitude, and strong service orientation under pressure. Safety Responsibilities Promote a positive safety culture within the workplace and attend any safety-related meetings or briefings as required within the job role. Comply with the requirements of RDMC RQHSE Policy and Safety Management System. Be mindful that Safety, Security, and Environmental protection are everyone’s responsibility. All staff members are accountable for reporting and intervening in any Safety, Security, or Environmental violations. Qualifications ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Degree in Mechanical or Civil Engineering. Knowledge Know the technology of the Metro track. Know the constraints related to the operation of the lines. Know Track Maintenance. Know distressing process. Knowing how to manage an emergency intervention. Know how to read and interpret readings from measuring vehicles. Know the methods of site planning. Knowing how to ensure the conduct of work on operated and unoperated track. Know how to use CMMS software. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers. Excellent computer proficiency (MS Office – Word, Excel and Outlook). Experience 3-5 years’ relevant experience in track maintenance. Experience in the change management culture. DESIRED BEHAVIORS Strong understanding of track infrastructure. Effective management abilities. Skilled in communicating at all organizational levels. Capable of supervision and operational control. Strong problem-solving and process mapping skills. Possesses analytical and critical thinking abilities. Proficient in negotiation and decision-making. Self-driven and enthusiastic approach. Strong numerical aptitude. Capable of handling complexity. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; fluency in spoken and written Arabic. Attentive to detail.
